note: The Jitter files to use for case-study films. Pick one that matches the frames a project actually has. Do not invent extra screens to fill a template.

templates.name: Image Stretch Transition
templates.motion: Each still opens from a thin center slit, stretched tall, and settles into the frame. Then it holds.

templates.name: Sliding Web Screens
templates.motion: Browser frames sit in a grid. The row slides until the next screen is centered.

templates.name: Project Teaser
templates.needs: A hero still plus a few supporting frames.
templates.motion: A slow opening hold on the hero, then a stretch through the rest of the work.

templates.name: Animated Mobile Screens
templates.motion: A fan of phone screens on black, front screens large, the rest stacked behind.

templates.name: 3 Mobile Screens
templates.motion: Three phones arranged together and animated as one group.

templates.name: Orbit: Social Media Showreel
templates.needs: A set of square or portrait social frames.
templates.motion: Frames orbit a center point in a continuous loop.

templates.name: Showreels
templates.motion: The showreel family: a teaser open, then the work moving as one reel.

templates.name: Sliding Smartphones
templates.needs: Three or more separate phone screens, about 375×812.
templates.motion: Rounded phone frames slide sideways. The center phone is full; the sides are cropped.
